item.title: At least 139 dead, 84 missing after migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti
item.description: At least 139 people, including 15 children, have died and 84 remain missing after a boat carrying more than 300 migrants capsized off the coast of Djibouti, the United Nations migration agency said Sunday.
